question_text: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
explanation: QuickSort worst case is O(n^2) when pivot is always smallest/largest (e.g. sorted array with first-element pivot). Average is O(n log n).

question_text: Which traversal uses a stack (or recursion) and visits root-left-right?
explanation: Pre-order traversal visits Root, then Left subtree, then Right subtree. Uses stack/recursion.

question_text: A hash table always has O(1) lookup.
explanation: Average case is O(1) but worst case is O(n) with many collisions (especially with naive hashing).

question_text: Explain Big-O notation and why we drop constants
explanation: Big-O describes asymptotic upper bound - growth rate as input approaches infinity. We drop constants because they don't change the dominant growth rate; 2n and 100n are both O(n). Important for comparing scalability, not exact performance.

question_text: Compare IaaS vs PaaS vs SaaS with examples
explanation: IaaS (Infrastructure): provider gives VMs/storage/network - you manage OS+runtime+app. Ex: AWS EC2. PaaS (Platform): provider manages infra+runtime - you deploy code. Ex: Heroku, App Engine. SaaS (Software): fully managed app. Ex: Gmail, Salesforce.
